title: JASPAR 2024's CORE collection of fungal transcription factor binding profiles, non-redundant: 178 position frequency matrices in MEME's format
provider: JASPAR, the open-access database of transcription factor binding profiles (University of Oslo, ELIXIR Norway, and partners)
format: MEME motif format version 4: the alphabet ACGT, a uniform background, then for each profile a line 'MOTIF <matrix id> <name>' (MA0363.3 REB1), a line 'letter-probability matrix: alength= 4 w= <width> nsites= <sites> E= 0' and w rows of the four probabilities of A, C, G and T, and the profile's URL.
coverage: 178 profiles of fungal transcription factors (non-redundant: one version per factor), JASPAR 2024 release
licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0), as JASPAR states for its data.
citation: Rauluseviciute, I., Riudavets-Puig, R., Blanc-Mathieu, R. et al. (2024), JASPAR 2024: 20th anniversary of the open-access database of transcription factor binding profiles, Nucleic Acids Research 52, D174-D182, doi:10.1093/nar/gkad1059.
used_by: domains/genomics (regulation: the filters of networks learnt from promoter activity matched to known motifs)
